answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the mesa check. Bindings are kept in relic, verified in willow, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each duplicate costs another 51 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
